newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mostly higher.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mostly higher.

text.p: NWE oil products mostly gained on Monday but naphtha was steady, traders said.
Gas oil climbed $8.75 on futures. Cargo premiums were steady with heating oil around Jan IPE +$6/7. Barges were inactive.
Gasoline barges jumped $7-8 on the back of crude oil but most demand was seen met for December.
Naphtha was steady with crude but end-users said supplies were ample and contango near at hand.
Fuel oil gained up to $2 a tonne mainly in the slipstream of crude although ARA bunker demand was good.
